title: Collecting and Organising Data
summary: Statistical questions, tally marks, frequency tables, class intervals and histograms.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 4: Data Handling and Presentation

objectives: I can ask statistical questions and collect data.
I can organise data in tally and frequency tables, including grouped data.
I can draw and read histograms.
misconceptions: A histogram is the same as a bar graph.
A value on a class boundary goes in both classes.
